owner_instruction_excerpt: Hermes has full control over both local Commander installations but uses them according to owner instructions or within designed automations. Design and build this setup.

owner_overrides.overridden: The prior Hermes-local Commander contract exposed a read-only inspection subset.
owner_overrides.ruling: Hermes owns the subordinate Commander and receives its complete pinned capability surface.
owner_overrides.effect: Tool filtering is removed from the Hermes subordinate Commander. Authorization is enforced above Commander through owner instruction, designed automation policy and immutable host-role boundaries.

owner_overrides.overridden: oracle-admin acted as the normal remote ChatGPT Commander foothold.
owner_overrides.ruling: Normal ChatGPT control terminates on dial-hermes-control. oracle-admin is recovery-only and must not receive project workload.
owner_overrides.effect: A dedicated owner remote Commander is installed on dial-hermes-control; GitHub plus OCI Run Command becomes the independent recovery route.
